finding: 固定能量反馈在两个新身体上都提高了相对开放的体时、并避免了本窗口内持续抑制出现的饥饿，但保留很大的能量代价。相对持续抑制的末质量优势只出现在多段体；紧凑体末M反低。原长体的结果没有成为统一策略排序。
english: The fixed reserve policy increased integrated body mass relative to open uptake in both preselected recipients, with substantial endpoint-energy penalties. Against sustained suppression it increased body-time and energy in both recipients, but endpoint mass decreased in the compact body and increased in the multisegment body. Both reserve paths had zero recorded starvation in this finite window. The compact body underwent repeated opening and contraction with translation; the multisegment body expanded into a spatial arrangement of ring-like units. These are conditional dynamics under different complete bodies and rules, not evidence of learning, general safety, or steady states.
